meta.title: Model Scorecard
meta.description: One row per configured (provider, model) route: response time, end-to-end tok/s, errors and a 0-100 technical rating folded from your own session history, an on-demand check of whether a route answers right now, and the context window, output cap and input modalities its adapter declares. Which of my models should I use for this task — with data instead of guesswork.
